name: onshape-mcp
description: MCP server for Onshape cloud CAD via REST API. Provides sketch, feature, import/export, drawing, and assembly tools for voice-driven CAD interaction with Onshape documents.

tools.name: create_line
tools.description: Create a line segment in a sketch

tools.name: create_circle
tools.description: Create a circle in a sketch

tools.name: create_arc
tools.description: Create an arc in a sketch

tools.name: create_rectangle
tools.description: Create a rectangle in a sketch

tools.name: create_point
tools.description: Create a reference point in a sketch

tools.name: add_constraint
tools.description: Add a constraint to sketch entities

tools.name: extrude_feature
tools.description: Create an extrude feature from a sketch profile

tools.name: revolve_feature
tools.description: Create a revolve feature from a sketch profile

tools.name: fillet_feature
tools.description: Apply fillets to edges in an Onshape part

tools.name: chamfer_feature
tools.description: Apply chamfers to edges in an Onshape part

tools.name: pattern_feature
tools.description: Create a linear or circular pattern of features

tools.name: mirror_feature
tools.description: Mirror features about a plane

tools.name: shell_feature
tools.description: Create a shell by removing faces from a part

tools.name: boolean_feature
tools.description: Perform boolean operations between parts

tools.name: get_part_info
tools.description: Get metadata and properties of a part

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List accessible Onshape documents

tools.name: create_document
tools.description: Create a new Onshape document

tools.name: export_part
tools.description: Export a part to STEP, IGES, or other formats

tools.name: import_file
tools.description: Upload an STL, STEP, IGES, or OBJ file to an Onshape document

tools.name: export_stl
tools.description: Export a Part Studio as STL

tools.name: export_step
tools.description: Export a Part Studio as STEP

tools.name: export_iges
tools.description: Export a Part Studio as IGES

tools.name: export_pdf
tools.description: Export a Drawing as PDF

tools.name: get_export_status
tools.description: Check the status of an export or import translation job

tools.name: create_drawing
tools.description: Create a new drawing in an Onshape document

tools.name: get_drawing_views
tools.description: List all views in a drawing

tools.name: add_drawing_view
tools.description: Add a standard view to a drawing

tools.name: export_drawing_pdf
tools.description: Export a drawing to PDF format

tools.name: list_drawings
tools.description: List all drawings in an Onshape document

tools.name: get_assembly_structure
tools.description: Get the full assembly tree structure

tools.name: list_assembly_instances
tools.description: List all instances in an assembly

tools.name: add_mate
tools.description: Insert a mate constraint into an assembly

tools.name: create_assembly
tools.description: Create a new empty assembly element in an Onshape document

tools.name: list_assemblies
tools.description: List all assemblies in an Onshape document
